hook: Zeros of the p-adic Eisenstein series E2 have j-invariants in finite unramified extensions of Q_p.
summary: For each prime p of at least 5, the zeros of Katz's E2 series give a handful of j-invariants, and all of them live in finite unramified extensions of the p-adic numbers. The authors use the supersingular polynomial and hypergeometric congruences, and also bound isogenies between zeros. Whether a non-CM zero can have an algebraic j-invariant stays open.
title: Zeros of Katz's p-adic Eisenstein series E2
